lines.text: Jeremiah the prophet gave a message to the quartermaster Seraiah, who went to Babylon with King Hezekiah of Judah.
Jeremiah had written on a single scroll about all the disaster that would come upon Babylon.
Seraiah was to read all the words aloud in Babylon and say the LORD promised that no one would remain.
When Seraiah finished reading the scroll, he was to tie a cord to it and cast it into the Euphrates.
Seraiah was to say that Babylon will sink and never rise again, and her people will grow weary.
